quests.instruction: What is the action word for working together with others toward the same goal?
quests.question: Cooperate
quests.hint: Think about working as a team to build a giant sandcastle together.
quests.explanation: Cooperate means to work together toward the same goal. We cooperate with our team to finish a project!
quests.funFact: Teams that cooperate well can finish big tasks faster and have more fun doing it!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for working closely with others to create something together?
quests.question: Collaborate
quests.hint: Think about painting one big mural together with your whole class.
quests.explanation: Collaborate means to work closely with others to create something. We collaborate to paint a big class mural!
quests.funFact: When people collaborate, they often come up with better ideas than working alone!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for joining in and taking part in an activity?
quests.question: Participate
quests.hint: Think about raising your hand to join in a fun class game.
quests.explanation: Participate means to join in and take part. We participate in games and activities at school!
quests.funFact: Participating fully in an activity helps you learn and enjoy it even more!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for adding your own part to help finish something bigger?
quests.question: Contribute
quests.hint: Think about adding your one puzzle piece to a giant class puzzle.
quests.explanation: Contribute means to add your own part to a bigger project. We contribute ideas to a group story!
quests.funFact: Every small contribution can add up to something wonderful when everyone helps!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for organizing people or things so they work well together?
quests.question: Coordinate
quests.hint: Think about planning who brings what so a class party goes smoothly.
quests.explanation: Coordinate means to organize people or things to work well together. We coordinate a class party with our friends!
quests.funFact: Coordinating carefully ahead of time helps a group event run smoothly!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for talking with someone to find a solution that works for everyone?
quests.question: Negotiate
quests.hint: Think about talking with a friend to agree on which game to play first.
quests.explanation: Negotiate means to talk to find a solution that works for everyone. We negotiate with a friend about which game to play first!
quests.funFact: Good negotiating means both listening and sharing your own ideas fairly!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for finding a way to end a disagreement peacefully?
quests.question: Resolve
quests.hint: Think about talking calmly with a friend until you both feel happy again.
quests.explanation: Resolve means to find a way to end a disagreement peacefully. We resolve a small disagreement by talking calmly!
quests.funFact: Resolving a problem calmly can help a friendship grow even stronger!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for each person giving up a little so everyone feels okay?
quests.question: Compromise
quests.hint: Think about taking turns with a toy so both friends get to play with it.
quests.explanation: Compromise means each person gives up a little so everyone feels okay. We compromise by taking turns with a toy!
quests.funFact: A fair compromise often helps everyone in a disagreement feel happy!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for making sure someone is part of a group or activity?
quests.question: Include
quests.hint: Think about inviting a new classmate to join your game at recess.
quests.explanation: Include means to make sure someone is part of a group. We include a new classmate in our game!
quests.funFact: Including everyone helps a group feel warm, friendly, and welcoming!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for giving someone a reason to feel excited to try hard?
quests.question: Motivate
quests.hint: Think about cheering on a friend so they feel excited to finish a race.
quests.explanation: Motivate means to give someone a reason to try hard. We motivate a friend to finish a race with cheers!
quests.funFact: Kind, motivating words can help someone find the energy to keep trying!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for filling someone with new ideas or the wish to do something great?
quests.question: Inspire
quests.hint: Think about how a wonderful story can make you want to write your own.
quests.explanation: Inspire means to fill someone with new ideas or excitement. A great story can inspire us to write our own!
quests.funFact: Something as simple as a beautiful picture can inspire someone to create art!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for recognizing that something or someone is valuable and good?
quests.question: Appreciate
quests.hint: Think about really noticing and being thankful for a kind gift from a friend.
quests.explanation: Appreciate means to recognize that something is valuable and good. We appreciate a kind gift from a friend!
quests.funFact: Taking a moment to appreciate small things can make every day feel brighter!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for treating someone or something with care because it matters?
quests.question: Respect
quests.hint: Think about listening carefully and kindly when your teacher is speaking.
quests.explanation: Respect means to treat someone with care because they matter. We respect our teacher by listening carefully!
quests.funFact: Showing respect to others is one of the kindest things you can do every day!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for believing that someone will do what they say?
quests.question: Trust
quests.hint: Think about believing a friend completely when they promise to keep a secret.
quests.explanation: Trust means to believe that someone will do what they say. We trust our friends to keep their promises!
quests.funFact: Trust grows stronger over time when people keep their promises to each other!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for deciding to stop feeling upset about a mistake someone made?
quests.question: Forgive
quests.hint: Think about feeling better and letting go of being upset after a friend says sorry.
quests.explanation: Forgive means to stop feeling upset about a mistake. We forgive a friend after they say sorry!
quests.funFact: Forgiving someone can help both friends feel much lighter and happier!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for comforting someone who feels upset after something difficult happens?
quests.question: Console
quests.hint: Think about sitting with a friend and comforting them after they lose a game.
quests.explanation: Console means to comfort someone who feels upset. We console a friend after they lose a game!
quests.funFact: Sometimes just sitting quietly with a sad friend is the kindest way to console them!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for telling someone kind words to help them stop worrying?
quests.question: Reassure
quests.hint: Think about telling a nervous friend that everything will turn out just fine.
quests.explanation: Reassure means to tell someone kind words to help them stop worrying. We reassure a nervous friend before a test!
quests.funFact: A few reassuring words can help someone feel calm and much more confident!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for welcoming guests to an event at your own home?
quests.question: Host
quests.hint: Think about welcoming your friends into your home for a birthday party.
quests.explanation: Host means to welcome guests to an event. We host a fun birthday party at our home!
quests.funFact: A good host makes sure every single guest feels warm and welcome!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for thinking ahead about how to do something before you start?
quests.question: Plan
quests.hint: Think about deciding all the steps for a fun day out before you even leave home.
quests.explanation: Plan means to think ahead about how to do something. We plan our steps before a fun day out!
quests.funFact: A good plan can help a big project feel much less overwhelming!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for deciding exactly when something will happen?
quests.question: Schedule
quests.hint: Think about writing down what time your soccer practice will start this week.
quests.explanation: Schedule means to decide exactly when something will happen. We schedule our soccer practice for after school!
quests.funFact: A clear schedule helps you remember exactly what to do and when!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for getting ready for something before it happens?
quests.question: Prepare
quests.hint: Think about packing your bag the night before an exciting school trip.
quests.explanation: Prepare means to get ready for something before it happens. We prepare our bag the night before a trip!
quests.funFact: Preparing ahead of time can help a big day feel much less stressful!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for putting things into specific named groups?
quests.question: Categorize
quests.hint: Think about putting all your toy animals into a group and all your toy cars into another.
quests.explanation: Categorize means to put things into specific named groups. We categorize our toys into animals and vehicles!
quests.funFact: Categorizing things carefully makes a big collection much easier to understand!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for grouping things based on what they have in common?
quests.question: Classify
quests.hint: Think about grouping leaves by their shape during a nature walk.
quests.explanation: Classify means to group things based on what they share. We classify leaves by their shape on a nature walk!
quests.funFact: Scientists classify animals and plants into careful groups to study them!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for putting things in order from best to worst, or first to last?
quests.question: Rank
quests.hint: Think about listing your favorite movies from your most favorite to your least favorite.
quests.explanation: Rank means to put things in order from first to last. We rank our favorite movies from best to worst!
quests.funFact: Ranking your favorite things is a fun way to think about what you enjoy most!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for choosing an option by raising your hand or marking a paper?
quests.question: Vote
quests.hint: Think about raising your hand to help your class choose a game to play.
quests.explanation: Vote means to choose an option, often by raising your hand. We vote to help our class choose a game!
quests.funFact: When a whole group votes together, everyone gets a fair chance to be heard!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for carefully choosing one thing out of several options?
quests.question: Select
quests.hint: Think about carefully picking your favorite color of crayon from a big box.
quests.explanation: Select means to carefully choose one thing from several options. We select our favorite crayon from a big box!
quests.funFact: Taking a moment to select carefully can help you pick exactly what you want!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for deciding which one you want out of two or more things?
quests.question: Choose
quests.hint: Think about deciding between two yummy flavors of ice cream.
quests.explanation: Choose means to decide which one you want. We choose our favorite flavor of ice cream!
quests.funFact: Choosing carefully helps you pick the option that makes you happiest!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for making up your mind about something?
quests.question: Decide
quests.hint: Think about finally making up your mind about which game to play first.
quests.explanation: Decide means to make up your mind about something. We decide which game to play first!
quests.funFact: Sometimes making a list of choices can help you decide more easily!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for telling the most important parts of a story in just a few words?
quests.question: Summarize
quests.hint: Think about telling a friend the short version of a movie you just watched.
quests.explanation: Summarize means to tell the most important parts in a few words. We summarize a movie for a friend who missed it!
quests.funFact: A good summary tells the main idea without every single little detail!

quests.instruction: What is the action word for trying something new to see what will happen?
quests.question: Experiment
quests.hint: Think about mixing two colors of paint together just to see what new color appears.
quests.explanation: Experiment means to try something new to see what happens. We experiment by mixing colors to see what appears!
quests.funFact: Scientists experiment carefully to discover brand new facts about our world!
